name: testNullNodeTest
input: pointer = any, node = any, test = null
expected: Returns true because if test is null, any node matches unconditionally.

name: testNodeNameTestWithNonElementNode
input: pointer = any, node = Text object, test = NodeNameTest
expected: Returns false because NodeNameTest requires the node to be an instance of Element.

name: testNodeNameTestWildcardNoPrefix
input: pointer = any, node = Element object, test = NodeNameTest with wildcard=true and prefix=null
expected: Returns true because wildcard without a prefix matches any element.

name: testNodeNameTestMatchingLocalNameAndNamespace
input: pointer = any, node = Element with local name 'foo' and matching namespace, test = NodeNameTest for 'foo'
expected: Returns true because both local name and namespace URI match.

name: testNodeNameTestMatchingLocalNameButMismatchedNamespace
input: pointer = any, node = Element with local name 'foo' and namespace NS1, test = NodeNameTest for 'foo' with namespace NS2
expected: Returns false because namespace URIs do not match via equalStrings.

name: testNodeNameTestWildcardWithNamespaceCheck
input: pointer = any, node = Element with namespace NS1, test = NodeNameTest with wildcard=true and namespace NS1
expected: Returns true because wildcard matches local name and namespace URI matches nodeNS.

name: testNodeTypeTestNodeWithElement
input: pointer = any, node = Element object, test = NodeTypeTest with NODE_TYPE_NODE
expected: Returns true because NODE_TYPE_NODE matches Element instances.

name: testNodeTypeTestNodeWithDocument
input: pointer = any, node = Document object, test = NodeTypeTest with NODE_TYPE_NODE
expected: Returns true because NODE_TYPE_NODE matches Document instances.

name: testNodeTypeTestNodeWithText
input: pointer = any, node = Text object, test = NodeTypeTest with NODE_TYPE_NODE
expected: Returns false because NODE_TYPE_NODE does not match Text instances.

name: testNodeTypeTestTextWithTextNode
input: pointer = any, node = Text object, test = NodeTypeTest with NODE_TYPE_TEXT
expected: Returns true because NODE_TYPE_TEXT matches Text instances.

name: testNodeTypeTestTextWithCDATA
input: pointer = any, node = CDATA object, test = NodeTypeTest with NODE_TYPE_TEXT
expected: Returns true because NODE_TYPE_TEXT matches CDATA instances.

name: testNodeTypeTestCommentWithCommentNode
input: pointer = any, node = Comment object, test = NodeTypeTest with NODE_TYPE_COMMENT
expected: Returns true because NODE_TYPE_COMMENT matches Comment instances.

name: testNodeTypeTestPIWithProcessingInstructionNode
input: pointer = any, node = ProcessingInstruction object, test = NodeTypeTest with NODE_TYPE_PI
expected: Returns true because NODE_TYPE_PI matches ProcessingInstruction instances.

name: testNodeTypeTestInvalidType
input: pointer = any, node = Element object, test = NodeTypeTest with an unknown/unsupported node type int
expected: Returns false because switch-case falls through and default return is false.

name: testProcessingInstructionTestMatchingTarget
input: pointer = any, node = ProcessingInstruction with target 'target1', test = ProcessingInstructionTest with target 'target1'
expected: Returns true because testPI matches nodePI.

name: testProcessingInstructionTestMismatchedTarget
input: pointer = any, node = ProcessingInstruction with target 'target1', test = ProcessingInstructionTest with target 'target2'
expected: Returns false because testPI does not equal nodePI.

name: testProcessingInstructionTestWithNonPINode
input: pointer = any, node = Element object, test = ProcessingInstructionTest
expected: Returns false because node is not an instance of ProcessingInstruction.

name: testUnsupportedNodeTestClass
input: pointer = any, node = any, test = custom or unknown subclass of NodeTest
expected: Returns false because the test instance does not match any known NodeTest implementation handled in if-else chain.
